experiences.name: W Trek Multi-Day Hiking Circuit
experiences.description: Embark on the iconic W Trek, a 4-5 day trekking route through Torres del Paine National Park covering the Valle del Francés, Grey Glacier, and the base of the Torres. Book refugios or campsites in advance. Given the late Day 1 arrival, begin the trek on Day 2 after a morning gear check and early park entry to maximize daylight hours on the trail.
experiences.location: Torres del Paine National Park, Magallanes Region

experiences.name: Mirador Las Torres Sunrise Hike
experiences.description: Rise before dawn and hike approximately 4-5 hours to the iconic viewpoint at the base of the three granite towers. The sunrise illuminates the peaks in golden and pink hues, creating a breathtaking spectacle. Schedule this for Day 3 or later to ensure you are well-rested and acclimatized after the late Day 1 arrival.
experiences.location: Sector Las Torres, Torres del Paine National Park

experiences.name: Grey Glacier Trek and Boat Excursion
experiences.description: Hike along the shores of Lago Grey to witness the massive Grey Glacier up close, with towering blue icebergs floating in the lake. Optionally add a short boat excursion to get even closer to the glacier face. Plan this as a full-day activity mid-trip when energy levels are high and weather windows are favorable.
experiences.location: Lago Grey, Torres del Paine National Park

experiences.name: Valle del Francés Condor Watching Trek
experiences.description: Trek through the dramatic Valle del Francés, a hanging valley flanked by glaciers and sheer cliff faces. This area is prime habitat for Andean condors soaring on thermal currents. The hike offers stunning views of Cuernos del Paine and multiple waterfalls. Best undertaken mid-morning to catch condor activity during peak thermal hours.
experiences.location: Valle del Francés, Torres del Paine National Park

experiences.name: Lago Nordenskjöld Kayaking and Wildlife Safari
experiences.description: Paddle across the turquoise waters of Lago Nordenskjöld with a guided kayaking tour, spotting guanacos, rheas, and Andean foxes along the shoreline. The Cuernos del Paine towers provide a dramatic backdrop. This is an excellent active rest-day alternative between major treks, and can be booked for the afternoon on lighter hiking days.
experiences.location: Lago Nordenskjöld, Torres del Paine National Park
